lead: Vanduul clans threaten the trade routes in Nyx. InterSec offers twelve contracts, from
depending on the contract. Most of them can be shared.

gruppen.text: A Vanduul strike group sits at a point in Nyx, and support waves follow the first strike.
A Mauler leads the group and should only be engaged with strong backup.
The Vanduul and the Shattered Blade fight over the same ground, and InterSec wants both gone.

neueSchiffe.name: Galaxy
neueSchiffe.text: The central module sets the role. The cargo module takes the hold from 64 to 720 SCU and adds an industrial lift and tractor beam consoles. The med bay module turns the Galaxy into a field hospital with tier 1 to 3 medbeds.

neueSchiffe.name: Liberator
neueSchiffe.text: Ground vehicles drive up the rear ramp into the vehicle bay. Ships fit in the interior hangar or set down on pads inside the hull and along the top. Ships and vehicles aboard can be repaired, rearmed and refuelled there.
